checked_claims.note: Forgetful Leray with only q=0,1 fiber rows, vcd(M_{6,5})=25 killing H^{26}(M_{6,5}), and no d_2 into/out of total degree 26 matches FND-0036; the single surviving E_2^{25,1} term yields an MHS identification H^{26}(M_{6,6})≅H^{25}(M_{6,5};R^1 p_* Q) and likewise on W_26. This is only a reduction, not a resolution of the target.

The puncture SES 0→H→R^1 p_* Q→Q(-1)^4→0 and the vanishing W_26 H^{25}(M_{6,5};Q(-1)^4)=0 are standard, so the surjection W_26 H^{25}(H)↠W_26 H^{25}(R^1 p_* Q) is fine. The pure-Tate kernel of type Q(-13) is not proved: it requires W_24 H^{24}(M_{6,5};Q) to be pure Tate, which is itself a near-top-weight Tate claim for (g,n)=(6,5) and is asserted without argument. Compact-support duality is also mistwisted as (21) rather than dim M_{6,5}=20.

Degree bookkeeping deg(W_5)=16 and deg(W_5⊗ω^{-1})=6 matches SRC-0004/packet, and the balanced free-pencil count dim=15+2=17 is a plausible main-component dimension. The argument never constructs the closed evaluation-failure locus, never stratifies by h^0, never treats unbalanced CE splittings or non-reduced support, and never identifies components, stabilizers, or stack-versus-coarse automorphisms. Packet-mandated C66-GEO-Z/H0/COMP work is absent; the balanced reduced relative |L| is treated as if it were already the closed pure-codimension-4 locus Z.

Load-bearing purity of both U and Z is unjustified. U pure Tate is a non sequitur from the CE resolution. Z pure Tate is deduced from an unproved ‘Hurwitz space is rational/Tate’ claim plus a category error that rational irreps of S_6 kill non-Tate geometric monodromy. Gysin H^{18}(Z)(-4)→H^{26}(M)→H^{26}(U) therefore has unidentified inputs; assembly to W_26 H^{26}≅⊕Q(-13) and the Poincaré dual ⊕Q(8) does not go through.

finding_candidates.statement: For the (6,6) CE evaluation-failure locus, the balanced reduced-support relative linear system over the Hurwitz space is an open piece of the failure locus, not a closed pure-codimension-4 subvariety of M_{6,6}; Gysin for (M_{6,6},Z) requires a closed (stratified) embedding after h^0 and splitting-type stratification.

finding_candidates.evidence: ATT-0021 Part 4: ‘The finite S_6-cover does not introduce any non-Tate local systems because S_6 has only rational representations.’
finding_candidates.statement: That S_6 has rational irreducible representations does not imply that an S_6-cover of a relative configuration/linear-system space carries only Tate local systems; geometric monodromy of the tetragonal family and configuration-space coefficients can still produce non-Tate summands.

finding_candidates.statement: Declaring the genus-6 balanced tetragonal Hurwitz space ‘rational/Tate’ and deducing pure-Tate cohomology of Z upgrades a predicted/possible motive to an unconditional theorem and is not a substitute for C66-TATE-SUPPORT.

finding_candidates.evidence: ATT-0021 Part 4: ‘On U, the CE resolution ensures that the lowest-weight cohomology of U is pure Tate’ with no spectral sequence, compactification, or boundary analysis.

strongest_attack: Gysin assembly (CLM-0004) is load-bearing and collapses: the proof treats the balanced reduced relative linear system as a closed pure-codimension-4 locus Z, asserts pure-Tate lowest weight for Z from an unconditionalized ‘Hurwitz=rational/Tate’ prediction and the false principle that rational S_6-representations preclude non-Tate monodromy, and asserts pure-Tate lowest weight for U by pure non sequitur from the CE resolution—without packet-required h^0/component stratification—so neither Gysin input is identified and W_26 H^{26}(M_{6,6})≅⊕Q(-13) (hence ⊕Q(8) after (21)) is not proved.
theorem_statement: The exact group W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q), equivalently W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21), is a direct sum of Q(8); a disproof must exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand in this exact group.
